observed_mechanics: 0x00c0ce85 XORPS XMM0,XMM0 / 0x00c0ce8b MOVSS dword ptr [ESP + 0x4],XMM0: the saved-ECX slot becomes a float local initialised to 0.0f. The receiver is safe in EDI, so overwriting the saved copy is free.
0x00c0ce91 TEST EAX,EAX / 0x00c0ce93 JZ 0x00c0cf43: the first stack word is tested as an integer. Zero returns 0.0f via 0x00c0cf43 FLD float ptr [ESP + 0x4], invoking no callee at all.
0x00c0cea2 CALL 0x00C0CE30 with (ECX = receiver, arg0, arg1) and RET 0x8, so the two words pushed at 0x00c0ce9e and 0x00c0ce9f are consumed. The result index is kept in ESI.

0x00c0cea9 CALL 0x00B5B800 with no argument setup at all. That function is 7 bytes: CALL 0x00B3D320 / TEST EAX,EAX / JZ / MOV ECX,EAX / JMP 0x00A42730, else OR EAX,0xFFFFFFFF / RET. It is a global lookup that answers -1 on failure.

0x00c0ceae CMP EAX,0x1654C10 / 0x00c0ceb3 JNZ: the sentinel is the ADDRESS 0x01654C10, not its contents. That dword is 0 in the file image, so this is a runtime-value test and the sentinel branch is not statically reachable.

0x00c0ceb5 PUSH ESI / 0x00c0ceb6 PUSH EDI / 0x00c0ceb7 CALL 0x00C03260: that function ends in a bare RET, so the two words survive and become the stack arguments of the next call. This is the compiler reusing one push pair for two different callees.
0x00c0cebc MOV ECX,EAX / 0x00c0cebe CALL 0x00F31500: that function ends in RET 0x8 and pops exactly those two words. It is called as (singleton, receiver, index).
0x00c0cec3 FSTP float ptr [ESP + 0x8] with ESP = E0-12 writes [E0-4], the same slot the non-sentinel arm writes at 0x00c0ced2. Both arms store the base value into one float local.

0x00c0ced8 MOV EDX,[EDI + 0xC0] then 0x00c0cee1 LEA ECX,[EDI + 0xC0]: the receiver of the virtual call is receiver+0xC0, and the vtable pointer is the first dword of that same address. So receiver+0xC0 is itself the polymorphic sub-object, not a pointer to one.
0x00c0cede MOV EAX,[EDX + 0x58] / 0x00c0cee7 CALL EAX: vtable slot +0x58, no stack arguments, ECX = receiver+0xC0. 0x00c0cee9 TEST AL,AL / 0x00c0ceeb JZ 0x00c0cf39.
0x00c0cef3 LEA ECX,[ESI + 0x1] / 0x00c0cefc CMP ECX,0x6 / 0x00c0ceff JNC: the compare is UNSIGNED, so the neighbour is table[index + 1] whenever index <= 4. There is no table[6] read.
0x00c0cf01 MOVSS XMM0,[ESI*0x4 + 0x15D9654]: base 0x015D9654 == 0x015D9650 + 4, so this is table[index + 1] of the same six-entry table read at 0x00c0cec9.

0x00c0cf0c TEST ESI,ESI / 0x00c0cf0e JBE 0x00c0cf1f: the base value is KEPT in the shared slot when index == 0. Unreachable given the [0,5] clamp in 0x00C0CE30, because index + 1 < 6 already covers index 0. A defensive branch.
0x00c0cf10 MOVSS XMM0,[ESI*0x4 + 0x15D964C]: 0x015D964C == 0x015D9650 - 4, so this is table[index - 1]. With the [0,5] clamp it is reached only at index 5 and yields table[4].

0x00c0cef6 MOVSS [ESP + 0x10],XMM0 is a DEAD store: with ESP = E0-12 it writes the same [E0-4] slot the base value already occupies. It matters only because 0x00c0cf0e can skip the neighbour load, leaving the base in that slot. The reconstruction models the slot as a single variable so both the dead store and the skip are preserved.

0x00c0cf29 FSUBR ST0,ST1 computes ST0 = ST1 - ST0. With ST0 = the slot value and ST1 = the first stack word, that is first_arg_as_float - v, so the absolute value is |first_arg - v| either way and the operand order does not affect the result.
0x00c0cf2d FMUL float ptr [0x01471064]: the file image at 0x01471064 is 3F 00 00 00, i.e. 0.5f.
0x00c0cf33 FADDP adds the base ST0 and pops, leaving v + 0.5f * |first_arg - v|.

sdk_correspondence.caveat: Spore-ModAPI is a third-party clean-room reconstruction, not original EA source and not EA documentation. Where it is cited below it supplies CANDIDATE NAMES only. The binary is the sole authority for every offset, constant, branch polarity and call shape asserted in this record.

semantic_contract: A two-argument tier lookup on a tiered scalar field. Returns 0.0f when the first argument is 0, invoking nothing. Otherwise it asks 0x00C0CE30 for an index clamped to [0,5], reads a base value either from the lazy singleton's float vector through 0x00F31500 (when the global lookup 0x00B5B800 answers the sentinel address 0x01654C10) or from the six-entry float table at 0x015D9650, and returns that base unchanged when the vtable slot +0x58 of the sub-object at receiver+0xC0 answers false. When that gate answers true it takes v = table[index + 1] for index <= 4 and v = table[4] for index == 5, keeping the base only in the unreachable index == 0 case, and returns v + 0.5f * |first_argument_reinterpreted_as_float - v|. The first argument is read twice from the same stack word: once as an integer zero test and once as a float operand, so the small integers 1, 2 and 3 that 0x00C0CF50 passes become denormals and the effective shipping-build result is v + 0.5f * v for non-negative v. The function writes no memory, calls no writer, and pops its own two stack words.
classification_rationale: Not STRONG_SEMANTIC. The complete body, the ABI, the control flow, both table addressing modes, the 0.5f constant and the slot +0x58 gate are all read directly, but three material elements are bounded rather than established: the owning class and concrete callee behind vtable slot +0x58 on the sub-object at receiver+0xC0; the runtime contents of the six-entry float table at 0x015D9650 and of the singleton's vector at +0x10, both of which are zero or empty in the file image; and the internal fill path of 0x00F31500, which was read only far enough to establish its return contract. Not STRUCTURAL_ONLY, because the whole arithmetic and every branch polarity are established, not merely the frame.
semantic_findings: The first stack argument is aliased: TESTed as an integer at 0x00c0ce91 and FLDed as a float at 0x00c0cf24. Ghidra's `param_2 == 0.0` and its `ABS(local_4 - param_2)` are the same single word read two ways.

Ghidra additionally aliases the zero-initialised local at [E0-4] onto that parameter, which is wrong. 0x00c0ce8b writes 0.0f into the saved-ECX slot. The reconstruction follows the disassembly and keeps them separate. Recorded as a decompiler correction.
The gate is vtable slot +0x58 on a sub-object that begins at receiver+0xC0 and is passed to the call as receiver+0xC0, so it is polymorphic in its own right.
The neighbour index wraps: (uint)(index + 1) < 6 selects table[index + 1], and the fallback is table[index - 1], which under the [0,5] clamp means table[4] at index 5. There is no table[6] read.
The averaging factor is the float 0.5f read from 0x01471064, and the formula is asymmetric: v + 0.5f*|a - v| equals the midpoint (v + a)/2 when a <= v, but equals (3v - a)/2 when a > v.

The three real callsites pass 1, 2 and 3, whose bit patterns are denormals as floats, so the float operand is effectively zero and the result is 1.5*v in the observed build. Asserted in the model test.
0x00C0CE30 adds receiver+0xFA0 to the index exactly when the second argument is 0, which is the only difference between the (tier, 1) and (tier, 0) call shapes.
0x00C0CFA0 caches this function's results in the four-float array at receiver+0xFA8 and short-circuits to 0.0f when asked for index 0, so the early exit is live.
0x00C0CEB7 and 0x00C0CEBE reuse one push pair for two callees with different cleanup conventions: 0x00C03260 is bare RET and 0x00F31500 is RET 0x8. The stack is balanced only because of that pairing.
unresolved_questions: Which class owns the sub-object at receiver+0xC0, and what is its slot +0x58? No vtable reachable from this function was located and the binary has no RTTI.
What is the boolean at slot +0x58? It is only ever consumed as a gate on whether the neighbour-averaged formula is applied.
What are the six runtime values of the float table at 0x015D9650? The shipped image carries zeros, so on the file image every path through this table returns 0.
What populates the singleton at 0x0168D824 and its float vector at +0x10? Only the lazy-allocation path of 0x00C03260 is read; the writer is not identified.
What is 0x0145F924, the type descriptor 0x00C03260 passes to the allocator? It is read as an immediate only.
Why does 0x00C0CE30 read receiver+0xFA0 and add it to the index? It is read only inside that callee and this worker did not reconstruct 0x00C0CE30's own inputs.
Is the sentinel test 0x00B5B800() == 0x01654C10 a type check or an instance check? The same constant is pushed to 0x00B3D320 inside 0x00F31500, which is consistent with either reading.
What is the name of the float at _DAT_0150C900 that 0x00C0CFA0 adds to this result? It was not read.
Ten of the fifteen recorded callsites were not individually disassembled.
runtime_gates: No original-process trace exists. A differential run must confirm the six table values at 0x015D9650 and the boolean behind slot +0x58 at the moment this function runs.
The sentinel branch is only reachable once 0x01654C10 has been populated at runtime; in the file image it holds 0, so the branch cannot be exercised statically.
The concrete receiver behind the slot +0x58 dispatch must be observed before the owning class can be named.
The value of the singleton's float vector at singleton+0x10 can only be observed at runtime, which also determines whether 0x00F31500 returns a real element or FLD1.
